01 — About

Building useful AI,
not just demos.

Galgotias University · B.Tech CSE (AI & ML)

I'm a final-year Computer Science student specialising in Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning, with hands-on experience across Generative AI, AI evaluation, LLM applications, and software development.

At Mercor, I work on audio data annotation, evaluation, and AI training validation — reviewing model outputs against detailed task requirements and providing precise written feedback.

Previously, at EduSkills Academy, I worked with Generative AI, LLM, and RAG-based applications using Python, PyTorch, Transformers, and Hugging Face. My research interests sit around retrieval quality, factual reliability, and reducing LLM hallucinations.

01 — Featured

CodeSentinel — AI-Powered DevSecOps Reviewer

An AI-powered DevSecOps reviewer that analyzes pull requests, identifies vulnerabilities, and helps generate secure code fixes. The system combines CodeBERT, StarCoder, OWASP rules, Tree-sitter, and taint-flow analysis through FastAPI with a React interface.

04 — Research

Research work.

Exploring retrieval quality, factual reliability, and hallucination reduction in large language models.

Confidence-Aware Retrieval-Augmented Generation

CARAG — Reducing Hallucinations in Large Language Models

Proposed an adaptive RAG approach that dynamically adjusts retrieval depth based on the query. The work evaluates the approach against a standalone LLM and a conventional RAG baseline across hallucination reduction, factual reliability, and retrieval efficiency.
